### New
- **Start the TV straight into OpenLauncher** (rooted TVs): Settings > TV > When the TV turns on. Works from the next full restart. A small check at every start puts the TV back to Live TV if OpenLauncher is uninstalled or a software update changes LG's start-up file.
- **Your own app icons**: Settings > Apps > Names and icons. Pick a picture from a USB stick or the TV's storage; it is kept inside the launcher, so the USB stick can come out.
- **Running apps**: see what the TV keeps open in the background and close one or all of them. Green button, or the Running apps button next to Edit.
- **My wallpapers**: one list for the built-in photos, your own pictures, videos and whole folders (USB or `/media/developer/wallpapers`) and links. Pick one and it stays; pick several and they take turns.
- **Faster start**: the home screen is drawn from the app list saved last time (about 0.36 s instead of about 1 s on an LG C2), then refreshed in the background.
- **Without root**: Settings > TV explains Quick Access, and `tools/home-watch` can open OpenLauncher from another always-on device when LG's Home shows.

### Changed
- Edit mode's hover buttons are now Hide, Folder, Uninstall and Move. Names and icons moved to Settings > Apps.
- The built-in looping video and the separate Picture source are gone; your Picture choice moves into My wallpapers. The download is about 23 MB smaller.
- App info shows only the essentials.

### Security
- **Updates from the app are now signed.** From this release on, the in-app updater only installs a release signed with the maintainer's offline key, checked on the TV before installing (HTTPS only). Releases also carry GitHub build provenance.
- A Content Security Policy stops any script but the launcher's own from running.
- Files that run as root at start-up, or are mounted into the system, now live in root-only folders instead of `/media/developer` or `/tmp`.
- Everything sent to the root shell is quoted.

If you set up **Replace stock Home** with an earlier version, press **Apply** again once (Settings > TV) to move to the safer setup.

Based on ideas from [Hearth](https://github.com/rudra-avatar/Hearth) (MIT); `tools/home-watch` is adapted from [webos-vibehack](https://github.com/OmkarK97/webos-vibehack) (MIT).

### Install
Download `com.homebrew.openlauncher_2.1.0_all.ipk` and install it with Homebrew Channel, Dev Manager, Discoverium or `ares-install`, or use **Check for updates** in OpenLauncher's App info.
